eventPackages.intro: One operation, one review. Inspect the entire proposal before applying.
eventPackages.emptyBody: No event package has been created. Discover channel models and prices or create a price draft to start a review. Changes are not applied automatically.
eventPackages.confirmBody: This action applies to every item, including items hidden by search or pagination.
eventPackages.drift: Published data changed after this proposal. A fresh correction is required.
eventPackages.terminal: This package is closed. Its history and result remain available.
eventPackages.noChange: Current prices already match. No package was created.
eventPackages.newApiIntro: Save one upstream URL and API key. Model and price discovery follows immediately.
eventPackages.name: Channel name
eventPackages.patHint: KEY is used only for model access. PAT verifies account and group evidence; it is never shown in results.
eventPackages.financialHint: Missing financial settings block procurement conversion, not saving the channel.
eventPackages.partial: The channel is saved. Retry only the unfinished stage; do not create it again.
eventPackages.operationMissing: The request result is unknown. Check this operation before retrying the same creation.
eventPackages.applyError: Action was not completed. Latest persisted state has been reloaded.
eventPackages.success: Result saved. Review the current state below.
eventPackages.referenceOnly: Reference only — not a procurement price
eventPackages.selectSources: Only this selected source is replaced after a complete fresh observation commits. Other packages remain unchanged.
eventPackages.conflict: The package changed. Reload before saving.
eventPackages.excludeConfirm: Keep published prices for these items and explicitly exclude the unresolved proposals
eventPackages.pendingIntent: This operation has an unconfirmed result. Keep the original input and check its result before starting a different intent.
eventPackages.mappingCorrection: Fix the channel model-mapping rules or public model configuration, then start a new discovery. This package stays unchanged.
eventPackages.noDifference: No changed field in this snapshot
eventPackages.PUBLIC_RATIO_OR_FALLBACK: Public ratio; configuration or fallback origin unknown
eventPackages.recovered: Recovered the previous operation result. New edits have not been saved.

issueCodes.GROUP_UNVERIFIED: KEY group applicability is not verified. Add account evidence before proposing procurement prices.
issueCodes.UPSTREAM_CONTRACT_UNKNOWN: The upstream version or pricing unit is unknown. Constant prices cannot be inferred.
issueCodes.BILLING_MODE_UNSUPPORTED: Expression pricing is not a constant price; correct or explicitly exclude this proposal.
issueCodes.MODEL_RATIO_PROVENANCE_UNKNOWN: The public 37.5 ratio has no verified origin; this remains an estimated reference.

eventPackages.canonicalAddress: Both addresses will use {{url}} when saved.
eventPackages.addressDrift: The existing console address is {{url}}. Saving replaces it with the address above.
eventPackages.filteredEmptyBody: History is preserved. Clear the search, type, target and queue filters to view all packages.
eventPackages.resetFilters: Clear filters and view all history
eventPackages.actionUnavailable: The action is no longer available. Current state: {{status}}.
eventPackages.recoveredStatus: The request response was uncertain. The saved package was reloaded: {{status}}.
eventPackages.actionUnknown: The saved result could not be confirmed. Reload this package before another action.
eventPackages.retainedNote: Your unsent review note is retained
eventPackages.initializing: Initialization request in progress; the channel is already saved.
eventPackages.awaitingReceipt: Waiting for the current saved stage result
